title: Padded-clone value equals clone value
statement: Let $E$ be a weighted constraint experiment with a uniform refinement over a finite predicate template. For natural numbers $r,M$ with $0<M$, suppose every outcome's predicate has arity at most $r$. For every assignment of values in $D$ to $V\times\{0,\ldots,M-1\}$, the padded-clone value equals the value of the experiment obtained by cloning each queried variable with an independently uniform index from $\{0,\ldots,M-1\}$.
hypotheses_covered: Every outcome's predicate has arity at most $r$
